message.quirky.totem_spawned: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — %s blocks from your spawn point
message.quirky.totem_spawned_cross: Your holding totem spawned in %s at (%s, %s, %s) — not in the same dimension as your spawn point
text.autoconfig.quirky.title: Quirky Config
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.mapPreview: Show a live map preview (with scale and lock state) when hovering a map in your inventory.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.harvestRep: Right-click fully grown crops to harvest and replant them in one go.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.doubleDoor: Opening one door also opens the matching door next to it.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.clockToolt: Show the day and time when hovering a clock.
Right-click equippable items in a container to equip or swap them; dedicated offhand items use the separate Offhand Swap option.
Eating a melon slice spits out its seeds.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.totemOfHol: Keep your inventory on death; a holding totem spawns where you died and drops your items when hit.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitsToRetr: How many hits the holding totem needs before it drops its contents.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spawnHeigh: How many blocks above the death point the holding totem spawns. 1 keeps it in reach; 2 raises it one block higher.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundVo: Volume of the sound when the totem is hit. Values above 1 only extend the falloff distance; loudness is capped at 1.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.hitSoundPi: Pitch of the sound when the totem is hit.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.retrieveSo: Volume of the sound when the totem's contents are retrieved.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.enchantPar: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a purple rune particle; higher values make particles rarer.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.endRodPart: 1 in N chance per tick to spawn a white light particle; higher values make particles rarer.
Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the white light particles.
Vertical spread height (blocks) of the white light particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleXz: Horizontal spread radius (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.particleYS: Vertical spread height (blocks) of the purple rune particles.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.modelScale: Display scale of the holding totem model.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.bobAmplitu: How far the totem floats up and down (blocks).
Floating period in ticks; higher values bob slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.spinPeriod: Rotation period in ticks; higher values spin slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.swayPeriod: Sway period in ticks; higher values sway slower.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.soulLighti: Torches and candles on soul sand/soil glow with soul-blue fire (lanterns are not supported on 26.2).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.shulkerToo: Show shulker box contents in the hover tooltip.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.foodToolti: Show hunger and saturation values with icons on food items, plus conditional consume time, status effects and special behaviors.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.attributeT: Show attack damage (with enchants), attack speed, armor and toughness as icons in a compact row, replacing the vanilla attribute section. Hold Shift for the vanilla tooltip.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.usageTicke: Slide out item count on pickup/use and armor durability bars on damage.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.deathCam.@: Play a slow pullback camera from your body before the death screen.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.ladderSnap: Look up to climb ladders and vines automatically (look down to descend, level view slowly slides without climbing).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.offhandSwa: Right-click a shield, torch, wind charge, or firework rocket to swap it with the offhand; independent of Quick Equip.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.tickerHold: How long the usage ticker stays visible.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.deathCamDu: Duration of the death pullback camera.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.quiverEnab: Enable the quiver — a dyeable ammo pouch that holds arrows and firework rockets.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.quiverCapa: How many item groups the quiver can hold (1-8, default 4).
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.enderPouch: Enable the ender pouch — a portable ender chest that opens your personal ender inventory.
Opening the pouch may startle nearby endermen (10% chance within 16 blocks), angering one.
text.autoconfig.quirky.option.petWhistle: Enable the pet whistle — call your tamed pets to your side, or taunt phantoms to the ground at night.
How far (blocks) the whistle reaches pets to path toward you (8-64, default 24). Pets beyond this teleport to you.
Teleport tamed pets that are further away than the whistle radius straight to your side.
At night, whistling drags 1-3 nearby phantoms down to the ground near you for 30 seconds of melee hunting.
Maximum number of phantoms taunted per whistle (1-5, default 3).
